scope: Explicit remote-label boundary for serial die-local search reference
words_u64: search_epoch: monotonically increasing across SparseSearch calls
request_id: nonzero correlation id; probe and its relax share an id
invariants: Exactly one receiver owns each canonical search label and queue entry
Probe and trace requests have zero payload words 3..7
Snapshot version is zero iff absent; absent cost is UINT64_MAX and ancestry/edge are UINT32_MAX
New label requires serialized coordinator credit; updates do not consume new credit
Accepted seed, close or relaxation increments label version without wraparound
Relaxation validates expected version, root/closed protection and strict cost/hops/parent/edge improvement
An identical retried update is rejected as stale and cannot enqueue twice; no cached-ACK exactly-once service is claimed
Wrong search epoch receives an empty epoch-reject response without mutation
Every captured request has a matching response with reversed endpoints and identical epoch/id/node
Monotone internal boundary labels have all incoming relaxations captured; their only unlogged transition is local close
Successful traceback packets match physical candidate cost, hops, parent and directed PIP through the attachment root

capture.header: Shared FPGAACCP 64-byte header, schema 0.1, type 0x44520020, architecture fingerprint, CRC64-ECMA, flags=1
capture.metrics: worker_transport.csv: per attempt and receiver, probes/protected probes/relaxes/accepted/rejected/traces/epoch rejects
capture.repeat_normalization: Subtract the first captured search epoch of each repetition; retain all other bytes and relative epochs
capture.wire_payload_accounting: 64 * captured packet count; the additional 64 bytes per record are archive metadata

limitations: Serial global-min arbitration, no asynchronous network or concurrent worker correctness claim
Credit is checked in a serialized coordinator; parallel admission needs reserved credits
Capture excludes seed distribution, queue-head arbitration, resource-authority summaries and physical framing
Independent replay does not reconstruct every local heap operation or every off-path accumulated cost
Fallback full-graph searches remain centralized and separately counted
No measured HBM, hardware latency, board performance or energy
